summary.overview: The M&A catch-up meeting focused on several key areas, including CRM and data management issues, updates on ongoing deals, and strategies for lead generation in the TSG project. Heather and Ahmed addressed confusion surrounding client statuses in the Close CRM and agreed to create a clean client-facing list by Thursday. Jack provided updates on the Eileen and Eric deal while discussing challenges with the Sharma deal, emphasizing the urgency to close both before the month-end. Additionally, the team reviewed outreach strategies for the TSG project, where Jack introduced a new approach to improve lead responsiveness.
